scope: Read-only discovery of existing features and proposed research-only additions for morning entry to same-day close. No production change or model promotion.
source_notation: Paths are repository-relative; start_line/end_line refer to the working tree inspected on 2026-11-09.
conclusion: Long-horizon low context is absent. Existing models already represent many short-horizon down-run, crash, rebound, volatility, volume, and candle patterns. Test new continuous interactions against the current served baseline, rather than relabeling existing inputs as novel.

existing_families.formula: return_nd[d]=Close[d]/Close[d-n]-1; log_return_nd[d]=log(Close[d]/Close[d-n]); momentum_spread_s_ld=return_sd-return_ld; signed consecutive close-change streak.

RSI uses exponentially averaged positive and negative price changes with alpha=1/n; stochastic=100*(Close-rolling_low)/(rolling_high-rolling_low); Bollinger %B uses rolling20 mean +/-2 standard deviations; Williams %R=-100*(rolling_high-Close)/(rolling_high-rolling_low).
existing_families.engineered: RSI2/14/28, stochastic5/14 and three-day signal, Bollinger20, Williams14, CCI20.

existing_families.clarification: Despite its name, this is current distance from a trailing close peak, not maximum peak-to-trough drawdown. No252-session low or low-age input was found.

existing_families.timing: Denominators include completed feature day; dataset shifts to yesterday.

existing_families.formula: gap=(Open-Close.shift(1))/Close.shift(1); day_range=(High-Low)/Close; body=(Close-Open)/Open; upper_wick=(High-max(Open,Close))/Open; lower_wick=(min(Open,Close)-Low)/Open; close_location=(Close-Low)/(High-Low).
existing_families.timing: Only overnight_gap is current/open-known. gap_volume_interaction uses its feature day's completed volume and is shifted; it is yesterday_gap*yesterday_volume_zscore, not today's gap times yesterday's volume.

existing_families.served_summary: All11 new volatility inputs, volatility120, Parkinson20/60, volatility delta1/3/5/10. ATR14 is computed but pruned.

existing_families.formula: Per-date advance fraction; fraction above ownSMA20; cross-sectional std of daily returns; up-volume/total-volume. Require40names; ignore each ticker before registry first_seen.

Ten-dimensional five-session path: dailyreturn/std20 clipped[-5,5], log(volume/mean20) clipped[-3,3], at lags0..4. KMeans6 trained only through earlier dates; score current path then partial_fit current date. Four outputs are nearest-center distance, second-minus-first distance, cluster crowding and leave-self-out mean peer return.
existing_families.timing: Centers are chronological; resulting completed-day columns shift once. first_seen membership applies.

existing_families.formula: Each input is a per-ticker expanding mean of strictly prior same-bucket open-to-close returns: values.groupby(bucket).transform(expanding.mean.shift(1)). Buckets use completed sessions and current open. They are not raw flags.
existing_overlaps: Two consecutive large negative open-to-close sessions, where absolute session return exceeds that day's close-to-close rolling20 standard deviation; capped count combined with current gap.
Yesterday session/ATR14 below-2 combined with prior capped streak and current gap.
Four negative sessions plus final absolute session/ATR14 above2.5 combined with current five-way gap.
Prior21-session decline below-30% and yesterday session above1%; or decline below-20% and yesterday absolute session below1%.

Current open at/below previous5-session low (pruned); negative-positive-negative session pattern (pruned); weak/strong previous close; inside/outside day; two negative gaps; two same-direction sessions.
existing_families.uncertainty_gap: No accompanying same-bucket support-count or uncertainty feature; a sparse mean may have one prior occurrence.

proposed_new_families.name: 252_session_low_context
proposed_new_families.novelty: No252-session low distance, breach or low-age feature found; distinct from prior5-day low seasonality and20/60-day distance from close peaks.
formulas: low252[t]=min(Low[t-252],...,Low[t-1]) using252 completed valid exchange sessions
low_age[t]=sessions since most recent occurrence of low252 among completed252 sessions
proposed_new_families.contract: Open distance/breach open-known; age as of prior close; require a complete specified warmup and explicitly handle tied lows.

proposed_new_families.name: two_close_selloff_low_and_rebound
proposed_new_families.novelty: Interactions add long-term low context and continuous rebound-consumed information. Current model has return1/2 and session-down buckets, so test incrementally rather than claiming two-day losses alone are new.
formulas: Interact shock1,shock2 with open_low_distance and rebound_fraction; retain separate continuation-below-floor and rebound-above-pre-drop-price states
proposed_new_families.contract: No current High/Low/Close. Do not clip negative or above-one rebound fractions into the ordinary near-low group. Frozen pre-shock sigma prevents the shock itself inflating its comparison denominator.

proposed_new_families.name: selling_pressure_exhaustion
proposed_new_families.novelty: Existing volume/candle primitives are already served; new question is their conditional change across the two-day decline, standardized to a pre-shock baseline.
formulas: Combine with previous close_location, two_close_selloff and current opening gap
proposed_new_families.contract: Close-known components shifted exactly once. These are exhaustion hypotheses; high volume can represent continuing information-driven repricing.

proposed_new_families.name: current_gap_prior_liquidation_interaction
proposed_new_families.novelty: Existing gap_volume_interaction is previous gap multiplied by previous full-day volume zscore, then shifted; this uses current opening gap.
formulas: Compare interaction conditional on two_close_selloff and low252 distance
proposed_new_families.contract: Explicitly open-known in training and recomputed in live inference; never substitute today's final volume.

prior_evidence.finding: Full-history volatility additions were essentially neutral; trajectory mixed; price breadth promising on only25post-registry dates.
Corrected full-history all19 improved top20 across3forward blocks, but meanIC fell0.1176to0.1149. Previously consulted ticker holdout shares dates and is not fresh future evidence.

Seven restored volume inputs improved top20 all3forward blocks; mean0.223%to0.425%, IC0.1149to0.1123.132-input Rank activated. Oscillator restoration barely changed mean return and worsenedIC; candle restoration hurt.
Dropping5zero-gain inputs improved meanforward top20 but worsenedIC/holdout top20; not promoted.
Volatility-normalized confidence gate exists diagnostically; stability benefit was not demonstrated.

production_history_gap.finding: Default production daily pull is1year; merged refresh truncates to max(existing,incoming)rowcount. A252-session feature has almost no usable training horizon until ingestion retains additional warmup and target history.
production_history_gap.consequence: Research may use the separate5year panel, but production adoption requires explicitly extending history, recomputing snapshots and validating train/serve parity. Do not modify production during this research.

reusable_data_and_validation.data_provenance: Massive split-adjusted daily bars fetched for2021-11-01through2026-11-06 using current registry names plusSPY.
reusable_data_and_validation.do_not_reuse_old_event_cohort: Old prepare_five_year.py filters one>=5%drop, excludesMRCY, imposes21sessioncooldown, and requires future21daysvalid. Use rawpanel for fresh morning-only eligibility.
reusable_data_and_validation.current_universe_limitation: Five-year panel projects current registry names backward; it is survivor/current-universe-conditioned, not a historical investable universe.
reusable_data_and_validation.live_eligibility_gap: Live scoring skips earnings-on-or-since-prior-session names. Unrestricted historical large-loss events may differ materially.
reusable_data_and_validation.price_quality: Production sanitizer checks positive finiteOHLC but not all bar-consistency/corporate-action issues. Use reproducible invalid-bar and split audits.

incremental_validation_plan: Freeze pattern definitions, price/liquidity eligibility,252sessionwarmup, outcome and missing-data exclusions before reading results. Publish all specified cohorts, including losing/sparse ones.
Use completed-session features plus currentopen only. Require valid currentOpen/Close for outcome, not future multi-day availability. Never infer the time of a low from dailyOHLC.
Keep repository deterministic tickerholdout excluded from discovery; record exacttickerlist and selectionmethod. Previously examined dates/holdouts must not be called untouched.
Report uniqueeventdates,tickers,events,meandailyreturn,eventweightedreturn,median,positivefraction,tailrisk,and fixed cost scenarios. Make weighting and costunits explicit.

For uncertainty, use date/weeklyclusterresampling of complete dateclusters, recompute the estimand in each replicate, preserve serial dependence and never call repeated ticker-days independent trials.
Compare eras separately using explicit dateboundaries; distinguish pooled eventweighted results from equalera or equalday estimates. Disclose current-universe and event/news eligibility limitations.

Only after descriptive evidence: matched walkforward challenger versus savedservedfeaturebaseline, one family at a time, selected within trainingfolds. Evaluate top20return,RankIC,FitMAE,tailrisk,costs and matched tradecount.
Maintain negativecontrols and sensitivity checks for52low alone,two-drop alone,rebound stage and simpleexistingfeatures. MRCY remains illustrative, not a selected validation target.
Do not promote or change serving/configuration based on this audit or descriptive historical screen; require separately reviewed forward incremental evidence and production lookback support.
confidence: High for source formulas, current saved-input snapshot, prune state, and documented experiment outcomes. No new predictive-effect claim is made by this audit.
